role: XCTest suite for HealthKitWorkoutExport's sample builders (per-tick HR, delta distance, METs-based active energy), their placement on the wall clock around pauses, the pause/resume workout events, and its SampleOptions gating (settings switch, Apple-Health-sourced sessions, Apple Watch HR not written back).
types: HealthKitWorkoutExportTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over HealthKitWorkoutExport static helpers
state: mem:HealthKitWorkoutExportTests.clock (computed: WorkoutWallClock at start, no pauses)
mem:HealthKitWorkoutExportTests.pausedClock (computed: WorkoutWallClock at start, one 600 s pause at active second 15)
toplevel: Stored property start = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_622_534_400) used as every workout's start.
